# ship-git

Your interface to the `git` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`git.annotations`](references/docs/git.annotations.mdoc) — AnnotationsByLine for the active diff file.
- [`git.branches`](references/docs/git.branches.mdoc) — Local + remote branches with ahead/behind vs upstream.
- [`git.diff`](references/docs/git.diff.mdoc) — Diff for a commit or 'WORKING'.
- [`git.log`](references/docs/git.log.mdoc) — Commit log up to `limit` entries.
- [`git.overview`](references/docs/git.overview.mdoc) — One-call shape for the git view's default route.
- [`git.status`](references/docs/git.status.mdoc) — Working tree + index status buckets.

## Commands

- [`git.branch_create`](references/docs/git.branch_create.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Create a branch in the caller's worktree (optionally checkout).
- [`git.branch_delete`](references/docs/git.branch_delete.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Delete a branch in the caller's worktree.
- [`git.checkout`](references/docs/git.checkout.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Checkout a ref/branch in the caller's worktree.
- [`git.commit`](references/docs/git.commit.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Commit staged changes in the caller's worktree.
- [`git.fetch`](references/docs/git.fetch.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Fetch a remote in the caller's worktree.
- [`git.init`](references/docs/git.init.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Initialize a git repository in the caller's worktree.
- [`git.pull`](references/docs/git.pull.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Pull (ff-only) in the caller's worktree.
- [`git.push`](references/docs/git.push.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Push the caller's worktree to a remote.
- [`git.stage`](references/docs/git.stage.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Stage paths in the caller's worktree.
- [`git.unstage`](references/docs/git.unstage.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Unstage paths in the caller's worktree.
